package.name: ur_cable_touch_pick_place_demo
package.description: Cable TOUCH-then-pick for the UR10e + Robotiq 2F-85. Subclasses ur_cable_pick_place_demo, but obtains the connector's pose differently: VISION supplies x, y and yaw (well determined, since they are lateral in the image), while Z -- the camera's depth direction and the weakest axis of a monocular multi-view fit -- is MEASURED by touch. The gripper closes its fingers and probes straight down until a very low force trips; the contact height is the connector's z. Roll and pitch are assumed zero, which is what makes a single touch sufficient. It then retracts, opens, aligns and picks. Perception comes from the SAM3 TIP pipeline (sam3-abhay), which unions the cable and connector masks so it survives SAM3 labelling the whole assembly "cable". Needs no torch.
